about: The A&P app and tool pages. premium names the Premium feature a page is (assets/premium.js; AnpCore gates it, spec decision 72): "tools" closes a Premium tool whole for free users; practice and review ("question-bank", "review") keep Foundations unlimited and draw other chapters from the daily allowance; "exams" allows one free exam. A page without it is free. scripts/build-anp.mjs writes each page's shell (head, header, SEO, a <div id="app"> mount, the page's script and stylesheet) from this file; the page's behavior lives in its script. Tools read their content from data/tools/<slug>.json. docs/anp-phase1-architecture.md.

apps.title: Practice questions
apps.desc: Anatomy and physiology practice: drill a topic, a body system or a core concept, mix everything you have studied, or retry the questions you missed.

apps.title: Spaced review
apps.desc: Your A&P spaced review queue: every question you missed comes back just before you would forget it, until you have it for good.

apps.title: Exams and TEAS practice
apps.desc: Timed anatomy and physiology exams: unit quizzes, system exams, A&P I and II cumulative finals and TEAS A&P practice, each ending with a full review.

apps.title: Flashcards
apps.desc: Spaced-repetition anatomy and physiology flashcards built from the glossary and the comparison tables, by topic, system or core concept.

apps.title: Your dashboard
apps.desc: Your anatomy and physiology mastery by topic, system and core concept, with lab practical and prediction accuracy and what to study next.

apps.title: Search the course
apps.desc: Search every anatomy and physiology lesson, notes page, glossary term and tool in the course.

apps.title: Study tools
apps.desc: Interactive anatomy and physiology tools: lab practical, predict the change, feedback loop builder, pathway tracer, graph reader, calculators and word roots.

tools.name: Virtual lab practical
tools.tag: Real figures with the labels masked. Name each structure, at your own pace or against the clock.
tools.blurb: Identify structures on real figures: explore, study, quiz, or a timed practical.
tools.lede: Name and find structures on real anatomy figures.
tools.title: Virtual lab practical
tools.desc: Practice A&P lab practicals online: identify labeled structures on real figures in explore, study, quiz or timed practical mode.

tools.name: Predict the change
tools.tag: Up, down or no change. Then the chain that explains it.
tools.blurb: Something changes in the body: predict what goes up, down or stays the same, then see the chain.
tools.lede: Change one thing in the body and predict what goes up or down.
tools.title: Predict the change: physiology reasoning
tools.desc: Train physiology reasoning: a perturbation happens, you predict whether each variable rises, falls or stays the same, then see the causal chain.

tools.name: Feedback loop builder
tools.tag: Stimulus to response, one slot at a time.
tools.blurb: Build each homeostatic loop from stimulus to response.
tools.lede: See how the body keeps a variable steady, then build each loop yourself.
tools.title: Feedback loop builder
tools.desc: Build homeostatic feedback loops step by step: stimulus, sensory receptor, control center, effector and response, then classify the loop.

tools.name: Pathway tracer
tools.tag: Put the steps in order. Then find the one that is wrong.
tools.blurb: Put the steps of a pathway in order, find the missing step, or spot the error.
tools.lede: Learn the order things happen in the body, one step at a time.
tools.title: Pathway tracer: body sequences
tools.desc: Practice the sequences A&P asks you to know in order: blood through the heart, conduction, the cardiac cycle and more, with step-by-step feedback.

tools.name: Graph reader
tools.tag: Read the curve. Name the phase. Shift it.
tools.blurb: Read values off physiology graphs, name the phases, and predict how curves shift.
tools.lede: Read physiology graphs and see how each curve shifts when something changes.
tools.title: Graph reader: physiology graphs
tools.desc: Learn to read physiology graphs: action potentials, the cardiac cycle, the Frank-Starling curve and more. Read values, name phases, predict shifts.

tools.name: Worked-example calculators
tools.tag: Every number, every step, every unit.
tools.blurb: Cardiac output, MAP, flow and resistance, and capillary filtration, every step shown.
tools.lede: Move the numbers and watch each physiology formula work, step by step.
tools.title: Calculators with every step shown
tools.desc: Physiology calculators that show every step: cardiac output, mean arterial pressure, flow and resistance, filtration pressure and total peripheral resistance.

tools.name: Word root builder
tools.tag: Split any term into parts you already know.
tools.blurb: Decode medical terms from their parts, or build a term from its meaning.
tools.lede: Break medical terms into parts to work out what they mean.
tools.title: Medical word root builder
tools.desc: Decode anatomy and medical terms from their prefixes, roots and suffixes, or build a term from its meaning. Linked to the course glossary.
